propositions: A transient git fetch hang from the GitHub mirror times out at 300s, raising SnapshotFetchError during produce_code_review_verdict
The adapter's blanket exception handler converts SnapshotFetchError to a BLOCK decision with review-error gap reason, indistinguishable from a genuine blocking verdict
The voter maps the BLOCK decision to a durable LLM-Review -1 vote and writes a dedup row, removing the change from backfill eligibility permanently
The backfill reconciler pre-filters on has_llm_review_vote and skips re-review of changes with any LLM-Review vote, preventing self-healing of transient faults
Retryable infrastructure faults (git fetch timeout, connection errors, TimeoutError) must return an ABSTAIN decision that posts no vote and writes no dedup row, allowing backfill recovery
